Address.Description: The set of elements that describes an address, including the street address, city, state, and ZIP code.
Address.Name: Address

AddressType.description: The type of address listed for an individual or organization.    For example:  Physical Address, Mailing Address, Home Address, etc.
enum: Doubled - up (i.e., living with another family)

ApartmentRoomSuiteNumber.description: The apartment, room, or suite number of an address.

BuildingSiteNumber.description: The number of the building on the site, if more than one building shares the same address.

City.description: The name of the city in which an address is located.

CongressionalDistrict.description: The congressional district in which an address is located.

CountyFIPSCode.description: The Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) numeric code for the county issued by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). Counties are considered to be the "first-order subdivisions" of each State and statistically equivalent entity, regardless of their local designations (county, parish, borough, etc.) Counties in different States will have the same code. A unique county number is created when combined with the 2-digit FIPS State Code.

DoNotPublishIndicator.description: An indication that the address should not be published.

Latitude.description: The geographic latitude of the physical address.

Locale.description: A general geographic indicator that categorizes U.S. territory (e.g., City, Suburban).

Longitude.description: The geographic longitude of the physical address.

NameOfCounty.description: The name of the county, parish, borough, or comparable unit (within a state) in 'which an address is located.

Period.description: The time periods for which the address is valid. For physical addresses, the periods in which the person lived at that address.

PostalCode.description: The five or nine digit zip code or overseas postal code portion of an address.

StateAbbreviation.description: The abbreviation for the state (within the United States) or outlying area in which an address is located.

StreetNumberName.description: The street number and street name or post office box number of an address.

Assessment.Description: This entity represents a tool, instrument, process, or exhibition composed of a systematic sampling of behavior for measuring a student's competence, knowledge, skills, or behavior. An assessment can be used to measure differences in individuals or groups and changes in performance from one occasion to the next.
Assessment.Name: Assessment

AcademicSubject.description: The description of the content or subject area (e.g., arts, mathematics, reading, stenography, or a foreign language) of an assessment.

AdaptiveAssessment.description: Indicates that the assessment is adaptive.

AssessedGradeLevel.description: The grade level(s) for which an assessment is designed. The semantics of null is assumed to mean that the assessment is not associated with any grade level.

AssessmentCategory.description: The category of an assessment based on format and content.
enum: Early Learning - Physical well-being and motor dev
Early Learning - Social and emotional development
Early Learning - Language and literacy development
Early Learning - Cognition and general knowledge

AssessmentFamily.description: The assessment family this assessment is a member of.

AssessmentForm.description: Identifies the form of the assessment, for example a regular versus makeup form, multiple choice versus constructed response, etc.

AssessmentIdentificationCode.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an assessment by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity.

AssessmentIdentifier.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an assessment.

AssessmentPerformanceLevel.description: Definition of the performance levels and the associated cut scores. Three styles are supported: 1. Specification of performance level by minimum and maximum score, 2. Specification of performance level by cut score, using only minimum score, 3. Specification of performance level without any mapping to scores.

AssessmentPeriod.description: The period or window in which an assessment is supposed to be administered.

AssessmentScore.description: Definition of the scores to be expected from this assessment.

AssessmentTitle.description: The title or name of the assessment.

AssessmentVersion.description: The version identifier for the assessment.

ContentStandard.description: An indication as to whether an assessment conforms to a standard (e.g., local standard, statewide standard, regional standard, association standard).

EducationOrganizationReference.description: The education organization for which the assessment was developed and in which it was employed.

Language.description: An indication of the languages in which the assessment is designed.

MaxRawScore.description: The maximum raw score achievable across all assessment items that are correct and scored at the maximum.

Nomenclature.description: Reflects the specific nomenclature used for assessment.

PlatformType.description: The platforms with which the assessment may be delivered.

ProgramReference.description: The programs associated with the assessment.

RevisionDate.description: The month, day, and year that the conceptual design for the assessment was most recently revised substantially.

SectionReference.description: The Section(s) to which the assessment is associated.

AssessmentScore.Description: Definition of the scores to be expected from this assessment.
AssessmentScore.Name: AssessmentScore

AssessmentReportingMethod.description: The method that the administrator of the assessment uses to report the performance and achievement of all students. It may be a qualitative method such as performance level descriptors or a quantitative method such as a numerical grade or cut score. More than one type of reporting method may be used.

MaximumScore.description: The maximum score possible on the assessment.

MinimumScore.description: The minimum score possible on the assessment.

ResultDatatypeType.description: The datatype of the result. The results can be expressed as a number, percentile, range, level, etc.

BirthData.Description: The set of elements that capture relevant data regarding a person's birth, including birth date and place of birth.
BirthData.Name: BirthData

BirthCity.description: The city the student was born in.

BirthCountry.description: The country in which an individual is born. It is strongly recommended that entries use only ISO 3166 2-letter country codes.

BirthDate.description: The month, day, and year on which an individual was born.

BirthInternationalProvince.description: For students born outside of the U.S., the Province or jurisdiction in which an individual is born.

BirthStateAbbreviation.description: The abbreviation for the name of the state (within the United States) or extra-state jurisdiction in which an individual was born.

DateEnteredUS.description: For students born outside of the U.S., the date the student entered the U.S.

MultipleBirthStatus.description: Indicator of whether the student was born with other siblings (i.e., twins, triplets, etc.)

Citizenship.Description: Contains information relative to U.S. citizenship status and its associated probationary documentation.
Citizenship.Name: Citizenship

CitizenshipStatus.description: An indicator of whether or not the person is a U.S. citizen.

Visa.description: An indicator of a non-US citizen's Visa type.

Contact.Description: This entity represents a contact of a student, such as a parent, guardian or caretaker.
Contact.Name: Contact

Address.description: Contact's address, if different from the student address.

ContactUniqueId.description: A unique alphanumeric code assigned to a contact.

ElectronicMail.description: The numbers, letters, and symbols used to identify an electronic mail (e-mail) user within the network to which the individual or organization belongs.

GenderIdentity.description: The gender the contact identifies themselves as.

HighestCompletedLevelOfEducation.description: The extent of formal instruction an individual has received (e.g., the highest grade in school completed or its equivalent or the highest degree received).

InternationalAddress.description: The set of elements that describes an international address.

Language.description: The language(s) the individual uses to communicate. It is strongly recommended that entries use only ISO 639-2 language codes.

LoginId.description: The login ID for the user; used for security access control interface.

Name.description: Full legal name of the person.

OtherName.description: Other names (e.g., alias, nickname, previous legal name) associated with a person.

PersonReference.description: Relates the contact to a generic person.

Telephone.description: The 10-digit telephone number, including the area code, for the person.

Course.Description: This educational entity represents the organization of subject matter and related learning experiences provided for the instruction of students on a regular or systematic basis.
Course.Name: Course

AcademicSubject.description: The intended major subject/s area of the course.

CareerPathway.description: Indicates the career cluster or pathway the course is associated with as part of a CTE curriculum.
enum: Law, Public Safety, Corrections and Security

CompetencyLevel.description: The competency levels defined to rate the student for the course.

CourseCode.description: A unique alphanumeric code assigned to a course.

CourseDefinedBy.description: Specifies whether the course was defined by the SEA, LEA, School, or national organization.

CourseDescription.description: A description of the content standards and goals covered in the course. Reference may be made to state or national content standards.

CourseGPAApplicability.description: An indicator of whether or not the course being described is included in the computation of the student's grade point average, and if so, if it is weighted differently from regular courses.

CourseIdentificationCode.description: The code that identifies the organization of subject matter and related learning experiences provided for the instruction of students.

CourseLevelCharacteristic.description: The type of specific program or designation with which the course is associated (e.g., AP, IB, Dual Credit, CTE).

CourseTitle.description: The descriptive name given to a course of study offered in a school or other institution or organization. In departmentalized classes at the elementary, secondary, and postsecondary levels (and for staff development activities), this refers to the name by which a course is identified (e.g., American History, English III). For elementary and other non-departmentalized classes, it refers to any portion of the instruction for which a grade or report is assigned (e.g., reading, composition, spelling, and language arts).

DateCourseAdopted.description: Date the course was adopted by the education agency.

EducationOrganizationReference.description: The education organization that defines the curriculum and courses offered - often the LEA or school.

HighSchoolCourseRequirement.description: An indication that this course may satisfy high school graduation requirements in the course's subject area.

LearningStandardReference.description: Learning standard(s) to be taught by the course.

MaxCompletionsForCredit.description: Designates how many times the course may be taken with credit received by the student.

MaximumAvailableCredits.description: The maximum amount of credit available to a student who successfully completes the course.

MinimumAvailableCredits.description: The minimum amount of credit available to a student who successfully completes the course.

NumberOfParts.description: The number of parts identified for a course.

OfferedGradeLevel.description: The grade levels in which the course is offered.

TimeRequiredForCompletion.description: The actual or estimated number of clock minutes required for class completion. This number is especially important for career and technical education classes and may represent (in minutes) the clock hour requirement of the class.

CourseIdentificationCode.Description: A standard code that identifies the organization of subject matter and related learning experiences provided for the instruction of students.
CourseIdentificationCode.Name: CourseIdentificationCode

AssigningOrganizationIdentificationCode.description: The organization code or name assigning the Identification Code.

CourseCatalogURL.description: The URL for the course catalog that defines the course identification code.

CourseIdentificationSystem.description: A system that is used to identify the organization of subject matter and related learning experiences provided for the instruction of students.

IdentificationCode.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a course by a school, school system, state, or other agency or entity. For multi-part course codes, concatenate the parts separated by a "/". For example, consider the following SCED code-    subject = 20 Math    course = 272 Geometry    level = G General    credits = 1.00   course sequence 1 of 1- would be entered as 20/272/G/1.00/1 of 1.

CourseOffering.Description: This entity represents an entry in the course catalog of available courses offered by the school during a session.
CourseOffering.Name: CourseOffering
CourseOffering.UseConsiderations: Created to host InstructionalTimePlanned, which the Ed-Fi v5.0 XSD places on CourseOffering rather than Course, and to give Section.CourseOfferingReference a resolvable target. Only the elements needed for those two purposes are modeled; the rest of the Ed-Fi CourseOffering type is out of scope for this pass.

InstructionalTimePlanned.description: The planned total number of clock minutes of instruction for this course offering. Generally, this should be at least as many minutes as is required for completion by the related state- or district-defined course.

CourseOffering.use_recommendations: Created to host InstructionalTimePlanned, which the Ed-Fi v5.0 XSD places on CourseOffering rather than Course, and to give Section.CourseOfferingReference a resolvable target. Only the elements needed for those two purposes are modeled; the rest of the Ed-Fi CourseOffering type is out of scope for this pass.

CourseTranscript.Description: This entity is the final record of a student's performance in their courses at the end of a semester or school year.
CourseTranscript.Name: CourseTranscript

AcademicSubject.description: The subject area for the course transcript credits awarded in the course transcript.

AlternativeCourseIdentificationCode.description: The code that identifies the course, course offering, the code from an external educational organization, or other alternate course code.

AlternativeCourseTitle.description: The descriptive name given to a course of study offered in the school, if different from the CourseTitle.

AssigningOrganizationIdentificationCode.description: The organization code or name assigning the course identification code.

AttemptedCredits.description: The number of credits a student attempted and could earn for successfully completing a given course.

CourseAttemptResult.description: The result from the student's attempt to take the course.

CourseCatalogURL.description: The URL for the course catalog that defines the course identification code.

CourseProgramReference.description: The program(s) that the student participated in the context of the course.

CourseReference.description: The course recorded in the course transcript entry.

CourseRepeatCode.description: Indicates that an academic course has been repeated by a student and how that repeat is to be computed in the student's academic grade average.

CourseTitle.description: The descriptive name given to a course of study offered in a school or other institution or organization. In departmentalized classes at the elementary, secondary, and postsecondary levels (and for staff development activities), this refers to the name by which a course is identified (e.g., American History, English III). For elementary and other non-departmentalized classes, it refers to any portion of the instruction for which a grade or report is assigned (e.g., reading, composition, spelling, language arts).

CreditCategory.description: A categorization for the course transcript credits awarded in the course transcript.

EarnedAdditionalCredits.description: The number of additional credits a student attempted and could earn for successfully completing a given course.

EarnedCredits.description: The number of credits a student earned for completing a given course.

ExternalEducationOrganizationNameOfInsti.description: Name of the external institution where the student completed the course; to be used only when the reference external education organization is not available.

ExternalEducationOrganizationReference.description: The external institution where the student completed the course (e.g., the original education organization for a transferred course transcript, or the provider for an online course).

FinalLetterGradeEarned.description: The final indicator of student performance in a class as submitted by the instructor.

FinalNumericGradeEarned.description: The final indicator of student performance in a class as submitted by the instructor.

MethodCreditEarned.description: The method the credits were earned.

PartialCourseTranscriptAwards.description: A collection of partial credits and/or grades a student earned against the course over the session, used when awards of credit are incremental.

ResponsibleTeacherStaffReference.description: The staff member that is the responsible teacher for instructing or monitoring instruction for student attempting the course.

SectionReference.description: The section(s) associated with the course transcript.

StudentAcademicRecordReference.description: Link to the student's academic record for a semester/school year.

WhenTakenGradeLevel.description: Student's grade level at time of course.

Credits.Description: Credits or units of value awarded for the completion of a course.
Credits.Name: Credits

CreditConversion.description: Conversion factor that when multiplied by the number of credits is equivalent to Carnegie units.

CreditType.description: The type of credits or units of value awarded for the completion of a course.

Credits.description: The value of credits or units of value awarded for the completion of a course.

EducationContent.Description: This entity represents materials for students or teachers that can be used for teaching, learning, research, and more. Education content includes full courses, course materials, modules, intervention descriptions, textbooks, streaming videos, tests, software, and any other tools, materials, or techniques used to support access to knowledge.
EducationContent.Name: EducationContent
EducationContent.UseConsiderations: LearningResourceMetadataURI and LearningResource sit inside a required xs:choice in Ed-Fi v5.0 - exactly one of the two must be present, never both. Ed-Fi scopes education content by Namespace, not by EducationOrganization.

ContentIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for the education content.

Cost.description: An amount that has to be paid or spent to buy or obtain the education content.

CostRate.description: The rate by which the cost applies.

LearningResource.description: This entity maintains information that describes content, materials, and informational resources that support learning.

LearningResourceMetadataURI.description: The URI (typical a URL) pointing to the metadata entry in a LRMI metadata repository, which describes this content item.

EducationContent.use_recommendations: LearningResourceMetadataURI and LearningResource sit inside a required xs:choice in Ed-Fi v5.0 - exactly one of the two must be present, never both. Ed-Fi scopes education content by Namespace, not by EducationOrganization.

EducationOrganization.Description: This entity represents any public or private institution, organization, or agency that provides instructional or support services to students or staff at any level.
EducationOrganization.Name: EducationOrganization

Address.description: The set of elements that describes an address for the education entity, including the street address, city, state, ZIP code, and ZIP code + 4.

EducationOrganizationCategory.description: The classification of the education agency within the geographic boundaries of a state according to the level of administrative and operational control granted by the state.

EducationOrganizationIdentificationCode.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an education organization by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity.

EducationOrganizationIndicator.description: An indicator or metric of an education organization.

InstitutionTelephone.description: The 10-digit telephone number, including the area code, for the education entity.

InternationalAddress.description: The set of elements that describes the international physical location of the education entity.

NameOfInstitution.description: The full, legally accepted name of the institution.

OperationalStatus.description: The current operational status of the education organization (e.g., active, inactive).

ShortNameOfInstitution.description: A short name for the institution.

WebSite.description: The public web site address (URL) for the education organization.

EducationOrganizationIdentificationCode.Description: A unique number or alphanumeric code that is assigned to an education organization by a school, school system, state, or other agency or entity.
EducationOrganizationIdentificationCode.Name: EducationOrganizationIdentificationCode

EducationOrganizationIdentificationSyste.description: The school system, state, or agency assigning the identification code.

IdentificationCode.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code that is assigned to an education organization by a school, school system, state, or other agency or entity.

ElectronicMail.Description: The numbers, letters, and symbols used to identify an electronic mail (e-mail) user within the network to which the individual or organization belongs.
ElectronicMail.Name: ElectronicMail

DoNotPublishIndicator.description: An indication that the electronic email address should not be published.

ElectronicMailAddress.description: The electronic mail (e-mail) address listed for an individual or organization.

ElectronicMailType.description: The type of email listed for an individual or organization. For example: Home/Personal, Work, etc.)

PrimaryEmailAddressIndicator.description: An indication that the electronic mail address should be used as the principal electronic mail address for an individual or organization.

IdentificationDocument.Description: Represents the valid document that a person uses for identification.
IdentificationDocument.Name: IdentificationDocument

DocumentExpirationDate.description: The day when the document  expires, if null then never expires.

DocumentTitle.description: The title of the document given by the issuer.

IdentificationDocumentUse.description: The primary function of the document used for establishing identity.

IssuerCountry.description: Country of origin of the document. It is strongly recommended that entries use only ISO 3166 2-letter country codes.

IssuerDocumentIdentificationCode.description: The unique identifier on the issuer's identification system.

IssuerName.description: Name of the entity or institution that issued the document.

PersonalInformationVerification.description: The category of the document relative to its purpose.

Language.Description: A method of written or spoken communication.
Language.Name: Language

Language.description: A specification of which written or spoken communication is being used.

LanguageUse.description: A description of how the language is used (e.g. Home Language, Native Language, Spoken Language).

LearningResource.Description: This entity maintains information that describes content, materials, or informational resources that support learning.
LearningResource.Name: LearningResource
LearningResource.UseConsiderations: Ed-Fi Common type, not a Domain Entity - it has no identity of its own and is owned by EducationContent (1..1, inside that entity's required choice). Ed-Fi scopes education content by Namespace on EducationContent, not by EducationOrganization. Ed-Fi's own element documentation for InteractivityStyle names three acceptable values (active, expositive, mixed) while InteractivityStyleDescriptor ships four - Active, Expositive, Mixed, Other. The four-value set is correct; the discrepancy is Ed-Fi's, so do not remove Other.

AdditionalAuthorsIndicator.description: Indicates whether there are additional un-named authors. In a research report, this is often marked by the abbreviation "et al".

AppropriateGradeLevel.description: Grade levels for which this education content is applicable. If omitted, considered generally applicable.

AppropriateSex.description: Sexes for which this education content is applicable. If omitted, considered generally applicable.

Author.description: The individual credited with the creation of the resource.

ContentClass.description: The predominate type or kind characterizing the learning resource.

DerivativeSourceEducationContentSource.description: A reference or URL pointing to education content from which this education content was derived.

Description.description: An extended written representation of the education content.

InteractivityStyle.description: The predominate mode of learning supported by the learning resource. Acceptable values are active, expositive, or mixed.

Language.description: An indication of the languages in which the Education Content is designed.

LearningStandardReference.description: Relates the competency, learning standard, skill and/or text complexity to which the learning resource is aligned.

PublicationDate.description: The date on which this content was first published.

PublicationYear.description: The year at which this content was first published.

Publisher.description: The organization credited with publishing the resource.

ShortDescription.description: A short description or name of the entity.

TimeRequired.description: Approximate or typical time it takes to work with or through this learning resource for the typical intended target audience.

UseRightsURL.description: The URL where the owner specifies permissions for using the resource.

Version.description: The version identifier for the content.

LearningResource.use_recommendations: Ed-Fi Common type, not a Domain Entity - it has no identity of its own and is owned by EducationContent (1..1, inside that entity's required choice). Ed-Fi scopes education content by Namespace on EducationContent, not by EducationOrganization. Ed-Fi's own element documentation for InteractivityStyle names three acceptable values (active, expositive, mixed) while InteractivityStyleDescriptor ships four - Active, Expositive, Mixed, Other. The four-value set is correct; the discrepancy is Ed-Fi's, so do not remove Other.

Name.Description: The set of elements that comprise an individual's legal name.
Name.Name: Name

FirstName.description: A name given to an individual at birth, baptism, or during another naming ceremony, or through legal change.

GenerationCodeSuffix.description: An appendage, if any, used to denote an individual's generation in his family (e.g., Jr., Sr., III).

LastSurname.description: The name borne in common by members of a family.

MiddleName.description: A secondary name given to an individual at birth, baptism, or during another naming ceremony.

PersonalIdentificationDocument.description: The documents presented as evident to verify one's personal identity; for example: drivers license, passport, birth certificate, etc.

PersonalTitlePrefix.description: A prefix used to denote the title, degree, position, or seniority of the individual.

PreferredFirstName.description: The first name the individual prefers, if different from their legal first name

PreferredLastSurname.description: The last name the individual prefers, if different from their legal last name

Period.Description: The time period for which the information is applicable or effective.
Period.Name: Period

BeginDate.description: The month, day, and year for the start of the period.

EndDate.description: The month, day, and year for the end of the period.

Section.Description: This entity represents a setting in which organized instruction of course content is provided, in-person or otherwise, to one or more students for a given period of time. A course offering may be offered to more than one section.
Section.Name: Section

AvailableCredits.description: The amount of credit available to a student who successfully meets the objectives of the course. Available credits are measured in Carnegie units, A course meeting every day for one period of the school day over the span of a school year offers one Carnegie unit. See publication: U.S. Department of Education, NCES, 2007-341, Secondary School Course Classification System: School Codes for the Exchange of Data (SCED).

ClassPeriodReference.description: The class period during which the section meets.

CourseLevelCharacteristic.description: The type of specific program or designation with which the section is associated. This collection should only be populated if it differs from the course level characteristics identified at the course offering level.

CourseOfferingReference.description: The course offering taught in the section.

EducationalEnvironment.description: The setting in which a student receives education and related services.

InstructionLanguage.description: The primary language of instruction. If omitted, English is assumed.

LocationReference.description: The location, typically a classroom, where the section meets.

LocationSchoolReference.description: The physical school location in which the section is taught.

MediumOfInstruction.description: The media through which teachers provide instruction to students and students and teachers communicate about instructional matters.

OfferedGradeLevel.description: The grade levels in which the section is offered. This collection should only be populated if it differs from the Offered Grade Levels identified at the course offering level.

OfficialAttendancePeriod.description: Indicator of whether this section is used for official daily attendance. Alternatively, official daily attendance may be tied to a class period.

PopulationServed.description: The type of students the section is offered and tailored to.

ProgramReference.description: Optional reference to program to which the section is associated.

SectionCharacteristic.description: Reflects important characteristics of the section, such as whether or not attendance is taken and the section is graded.

SectionIdentifier.description: The local identifier assigned to a section.

SectionName.description: A locally-defined name for the section, generally created to make the section more recognizable in informal contexts and generally distinct from the section identifier.

SectionType.description: Specifies whether the section is for attendance only, credit only, or both.

SequenceOfCourse.description: When a section is part of a sequence of parts for a course, the number of the sequence. If the course has only one part, the value of this section attribute should be 1.

Session.Description: A specific designated unit of time during which instruction is provided, grades are reported and academic credits are awarded to students (whenever applicable). Sessions serve as organized segments of the academic year and can be interrupted by vacations or other events.
Session.Name: Session

AcademicWeekReference.description: The academic weeks associated with the school year.

BeginDate.description: Month, day, and year of the first day of the session.

EndDate.description: Month, day and year of the last day of the session.

GradingPeriodReference.description: Grading periods associated with the session.

SchoolReference.description: Relates the session to the school.

SchoolYear.description: The identifier for the school year.

SessionName.description: The identifier for the calendar for the academic session.

Term.description: A descriptor value to indicate the term that the session is associated with.

TotalInstructionalDays.description: The total number of instructional days in the school calendar.

Student.Description: This entity represents an individual for whom instruction, services, and/or care are provided in an early childhood, elementary, or secondary educational program under the jurisdiction of a school, education agency or other institution or program. A student is a person who has been enrolled in a school or other educational institution.
Student.Name: Student

BirthData.description: The set of elements that capture relevant data regarding a person's birth, including birth date and place of birth.

Citizenship.description: Contains information relative to U.S. citizenship status and its associated probationary documentation.

Name.description: Full legal name of the person.

OtherName.description: Other names (e.g., alias, nickname, previous legal name) associated with a person.

PersonReference.description: Relates the student to a generic person.

StudentUniqueId.description: A unique alphanumeric code assigned to a student.

StudentAssessment.Description: This entity represents the analysis or scoring of a student's response on an assessment. The analysis results in a value that represents a student's performance on a set of items on a test.
StudentAssessment.Name: StudentAssessment

Accommodation.description: The specific type of special variation used in how an examination is presented, how it is administered, or how the test taker is allowed to respond. This generally refers to changes that do not substantially alter what the examination measures. The proper use of accommodations does not substantially change academic level or performance criteria.

AdministrationDate.description: The date and time an assessment was completed by the student. The use of ISO-8601 formats with a timezone designator (UTC or time offset) is recommended in order to prevent ambiguity due to time zones.

AdministrationEndDate.description: The date and time an assessment administration ended.

AdministrationEnvironment.description: The environment in which the test was administered.

AdministrationLanguage.description: The language in which an assessment is written and/or administered.

AssessedMinutes.description: Reported time student was assessed in minutes.

AssessmentPeriod.description: The period or window in which an assessment is supposed to be administered.

AssessmentReference.description: Reference to the assessment taken by the student.

EventCircumstance.description: An unusual event occurred during the administration of the assessment. This could include fire alarm, student became ill, etc.
enum: Student took this grade level assessment last year

EventDescription.description: Describes special events that occur before during or after the assessment session that may impact use of results.

PerformanceLevel.description: The performance level(s) achieved for the student assessment.

PlatformType.description: The platform with which the assessment was delivered to the student during the assessment session.

ReasonNotTested.description: The primary reason student is not tested.

ReportedSchoolIdentifier.description: A reported school identifier for the school the enrollment at the time of the assessment used when the assigned SchoolId is not known by the assessment vendor.

ReportedSchoolReference.description: The school reference reported as the school the enrollment at the time of the assessment using the assigned SchoolId.

RetestIndicator.description: Indicator if the test was a retake.

SchoolYear.description: The school year for which the assessment was administered to a student. Among other uses, handles cases in which a student takes a prior-year exam in a subsequent school year during an exam re-test.

ScoreResult.description: A meaningful score or statistical expression of the performance of an individual. The results can be expressed as a number, percentile, range, level, etc.

SerialNumber.description: The unique number for the assessment form or answer document.

StudentAssessmentIdentifier.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an assessment administered to a student.

StudentAssessmentItem.description: The student's response to an assessment item and the item-level scores such as correct, incorrect, or met standard.

StudentObjectiveAssessment.description: The student's score and/or performance levels earned for an objective assessment.

StudentReference.description: Reference to the student associated with the assessment.

WhenAssessedGradeLevel.description: The grade level of a student when assessed.

StudentContactAssociation.Description: This association relates students to their parents, guardians, or caretakers.
StudentContactAssociation.Name: StudentContactAssociation

ContactPriority.description: The numeric order of the preferred sequence or priority of contact.

ContactReference.description: The contact associated with the student.

ContactRestrictions.description: Restrictions for student and/or teacher contact with the individual (e.g., the student may not be picked up by the individual).

EmergencyContactStatus.description: Indicator of whether the person is a designated emergency contact for the student.

LegalGuardian.description: Indicator of whether the person is a legal guardian for the student.

LivesWith.description: Indicator of whether the student lives with the associated contact.

PrimaryContactStatus.description: Indicator of whether the person is a primary contact for the student.

Relation.description: The nature of an individual's relationship to a student, primarily used to capture family relationships.

StudentReference.description: The student associated with the contact.

StudentEducationOrganizationAssociation.Description: This association represents student information as reported in the context of the student's relationship to the education organization. Enrollment relationship semantics are covered by StudentSchoolAssociation.
StudentEducationOrganizationAssociation.Name: StudentEducationOrganizationAssociation

Address.description: The set of elements that describes an address, including the street address, city, state, and ZIP code.

AncestryEthnicOrigin.description: The original peoples or cultures with which the individual identifies.

BarrierToInternetAccessInResidence.description: An indication of the barrier to having internet access in the student's primary place of residence.

CohortYear.description: The type and year of a cohort (e.g., 9th grade) the student belongs to as determined by the year that student entered a specific grade.

Disability.description: The disability condition(s) that best describes an individual's impairment, as determined by evaluation(s) conducted by the education organization.

EducationOrganizationReference.description: A reference to the education organization representing the context of the student information.

ElectronicMail.description: The numbers, letters, and symbols used to identify an electronic mail (e-mail) user within the network to which the individual or organization belongs.

GenderIdentity.description: The student's gender as last reported to the education organization.

HispanicLatinoEthnicity.description: An indication that the individual traces his or her origin or descent to Mexico, Puerto Rico, Cuba, Central, and South America, and other Spanish cultures, regardless of race, as last reported to the education organization. The term, "Spanish origin," can be used in addition to "Hispanic or Latino."

InternationalAddress.description: The set of elements that describes an international address.

InternetAccessInResidence.description: An indication of whether the student is able to access the internet in their primary place of residence.

InternetAccessTypeInResidence.description: The primary type of internet service used in the student's primary place of residence.

InternetPerformanceInResidence.description: An indication of whether the student can complete the full range of learning activities, including video streaming and assignment upload, without interruptions caused by poor internet performance in their primary place of residence.

Language.description: The language(s) the individual uses to communicate. It is strongly recommended that entries use only ISO 639-3 language codes.

LimitedEnglishProficiency.description: An indication that the student has been identified as limited English proficient by the Language Proficiency Assessment Committee (LPAC), or English proficient.

LoginId.description: The login ID for the user; used for security access control interface.

PrimaryLearningDeviceAccess.description: An indication of whether the primary learning device is shared or not shared with another individual.

PrimaryLearningDeviceAwayFromSchool.description: The type of device the student uses most often to complete learning activities away from school.

PrimaryLearningDeviceProvider.description: The provider of the primary learning device.

ProfileThumbnail.description: Locator reference for the student photo. The specification for that reference is left to local definition.

Race.description: The general racial category which most clearly reflects the individual's recognition of his or her community or with which the individual most identifies as last reported to the education organization. The data model allows for multiple entries so that each individual can specify all appropriate races.

Sex.description: The student's birth sex as reported to the education organization.

StudentCharacteristic.description: Reflects important characteristics of a student. If a student has a characteristic present, that characteristic is considered true or active for that student. If a characteristic is not present, no assumption is made as to the applicability of the characteristic, but local policy may dictate otherwise.

StudentIdentificationCode.description: A coding scheme that is used for identification and record-keeping purposes by schools, social services, or other agencies to refer to a student.

StudentIndicator.description: An indicator or metric computed for the student (e.g., at risk).

SupporterMilitaryConnection.description: Military connection of the person/people whom the student is a dependent of.

Telephone.description: The 10-digit telephone number, including the area code, for the person.

TribalAffiliation.description: An American Indian tribe with which the student is affiliated as last reported to the education organization.
enum: Inupiat Community of the Arctic Slope
Sac & Fox Nation of Missouri in KS & NE

StudentHomelessProgramAssociation.Description: This association represents the McKinney-Vento Homeless Program program(s) that a student participates in or from which the student receives services.
StudentHomelessProgramAssociation.Name: StudentHomelessProgramAssociation

AwaitingFosterCare.description: State defined definition for awaiting foster care.

HomelessPrimaryNighttimeResidence.description: The primary nighttime residence of the student at the time the student is identified as homeless.

HomelessProgramService.description: Indicates the service(s) being provided to the student by the homeless program.

HomelessUnaccompaniedYouth.description: A homeless unaccompanied youth is a youth who is not in the physical custody of a parent or guardian and who fits the McKinney-Vento definition of homeless. Students must be both unaccompanied and homeless to be included as an unaccompanied homeless youth.

StudentIdentificationCode.Description: A coding scheme that is used for identification and record-keeping purposes by schools, social services or other agencies to refer to a student.
StudentIdentificationCode.Name: StudentIdentificationCode

AssigningOrganizationIdentificationCode.description: The organization code or name assigning the StudentIdentificationCode.

IdentificationCode.description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a student by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity.

StudentIdentificationSystem.description: A coding scheme that is used for identification and record-keeping purposes by schools, social services, or other agencies to refer to a student.

StudentMigrantEducationProgramAssociatio.Description: This association represents the migrant education program(s) that a student participates in or receives services from. The association is an extension of the StudentProgramAssociation with added elements particular to migrant education programs.
StudentMigrantEducationProgramAssociatio.Name: StudentMigrantEducationProgramAssociation
StudentMigrantEducationProgramAssociatio.UseConsiderations: Extends the Ed-Fi GeneralStudentProgramAssociation base class, which contributes StudentReference, ProgramReference, EducationOrganizationReference, BeginDate, EndDate, ReasonExited, ServedOutsideOfRegularSession and ProgramParticipationStatus. Those base-class elements are not modeled separately on this entity.

ContinuationOfServicesReason.description: The "continuation of services" provision found in Section 1304(e) of the statute provides that (1) a child who ceases to be a migratory child during a school term shall be eligible for services until the end of such term; (2) a child who is no longer a migratory child may continue to receive services for one additional school year, but only if comparable services are not available through other programs; and (3) secondary school students who were eligible for services in secondary school may continue to be served through credit accrual programs until graduation. Only students who received services at any time during their 36 month eligibility period may continue to receive services (not necessarily the same service).
enum: Ceased to be migratory during previous term
Ceased to be migratory during school term

EligibilityExpirationDate.description: The eligibility expiration date is used to determine end of eligibility and to account for a child's eligibility expiring earlier than 36 months from the child's QAD. A child's eligibility would end earlier than 36 months from the child's QAD, if the child is no longer entitled to a free public education (e.g., graduated with a high school diploma, obtained a high school equivalency diploma (HSED), or for other reasons as determined by states' requirements), or if the child passes away.

LastQualifyingMove.description: Date the last qualifying move occurred; used to compute MEP status.

MigrantEducationProgramService.description: Indicates the service(s) being provided to the student by the migrant education program.

PriorityForServices.description: Report migratory children who are classified as having "priority for services" because they are failing, or most at risk of failing to meet the state's challenging state academic content standards and challenging state student academic achievement standards, and their education has been interrupted during the regular school year.

QualifyingArrivalDate.description: The qualifying arrival date (QAD) is the date the child joins the worker who has already moved, or the date when the worker joins the child who has already moved. The QAD is the date that the child's eligibility for the MEP begins. The QAD is not affected by subsequent non-qualifying moves.

StateResidencyDate.description: The verified state residency for the student.

USInitialEntry.description: The month, day, and year on which the student first entered the U.S.

USInitialSchoolEntry.description: The month, day, and year on which the student first entered a U.S. school.

USMostRecentEntry.description: The month, day, and year of the student's most recent entry into the U.S.

StudentMigrantEducationProgramAssociatio.use_recommendations: Extends the Ed-Fi GeneralStudentProgramAssociation base class, which contributes StudentReference, ProgramReference, EducationOrganizationReference, BeginDate, EndDate, ReasonExited, ServedOutsideOfRegularSession and ProgramParticipationStatus. Those base-class elements are not modeled separately on this entity.

Telephone.Description: The 10-digit telephone number, including the area code, of an individual or organization.
Telephone.Name: Telephone

DoNotPublishIndicator.description: An indication that the telephone number should not be published.

OrderOfPriority.description: The order of priority assigned to telephone numbers to define which number to attempt first, second, etc.

TelephoneNumber.description: The telephone number including the area code, and extension, if applicable.

TelephoneNumberType.description: The type of communication number listed for an individual or organization.

TextMessageCapabilityIndicator.description: An indication that the telephone number is technically capable of sending and receiving Short Message Service (SMS) text messages.
